description: Get historical search volume estimates for a list of keywords using the Google Ads Keyword Planner. Returns avg monthly searches, competition level, and CPC bid range for each keyword.

geo_target_constants.description: Geo target resource names, e.g. ['geoTargetConstants/2840'] for US. Defaults to US if omitted.

keywords.description: List of keywords to get volume estimates for (max 20 per call)

language.description: Language resource name, e.g. 'languageConstants/1000' for English. Defaults to English if omitted.

name: google_ads_keyword_volume
